author: Vasyl Trefilov
modifications: Exposed upstream CLI through a public native Rust run_from library function; retained original binary as thin entry point
Added Forge9070 frontend, RX 9070 XT Vulkan profile, read-only doctor, GGUF metadata preflight, Windows/Linux scripts and synthetic CPU/API tests
Added Hugging Face repository search, immutable revisions, namespaced streaming/resumable downloads, checksum checks and provenance
Added recursive model catalog, explicit load/unload, stale OpenAI model ID rejection, browser HF manager and model-switch regression tests
Added WSL native CPU/Vulkan launchers and explicit Windows executable interoperability launcher with documented runtime distinctions
Replaced leaked synthesized weight buffers and unsafe owned LoRA views with model-owned tensor storage and borrow-scoped views
Restricted user-facing catalog/download/load paths to sparse MoE models whose actual GGUF headers, shard geometry and tensor formats pass one shared policy
Exposed model-checked MTP and up to four GPU request slots, added bounded remote metadata workers and a concurrency throughput benchmark
Added optional output-changing expert-tail omission for uncached main-model decode/verification assignments; exact default, prefill and draft head retained
Added hardware tuning entry point and per-checkpoint routing/calibration cache identity with configuration matching
Changed the fidelity profile to retain every selected expert, default to F16 KV and one request slot; expert-tail omission is rejected by the Forge frontend
Fixed greedy GPU position-buffer preparation and made CPU sampling reject mixed non-finite logits
Changed calibration to warm decode measurements with baseline-token parity gates and explicit workload/configuration reporting
Added actual-tensor low-bit compression reporting and explicit model-file selection rather than size-only recommendations
Reject non-neutral unsupported OpenAI sampling options and capture execution settings during concurrent API benchmarks
Added bounded owned expert-RAM caches, native direct-read attempts with counted buffered fallback, lazy PLE and prefill protection
Added code-context packing, explicit request budgets, bounded admission and coding-client API support
Added the independent MIT-licensed forge-engine crate with native Rust CPU and Vulkan implementations, model format validation, templates and synthetic numerical tests
Added native configuration UI, complete-shard model discovery, persistent settings and Windows/WSL launchers
Prepared public repository documentation, original branding, contributor templates and native build/release workflows; engine runtime behavior unchanged
Corrected native wildcard-listener Host validation to use the accepted socket interface, with authentication and foreign-Host regression coverage
Hardened CI and release provenance; omitted 21 optional upstream benchmark captures/logs and made optional reference-runner paths configurable; retained build/test fixtures and licences

avalon_reference.scope: Source audit and independently implemented bounded expert-RAM and GPU caches, available-memory budgeting, lazy PLE rows, protected expert leases and prefill cache protection. Every selected expert is retained. No HIP kernel port, custom IQ3_KS, transfer/compute overlap or elastic KV-cache reuse is claimed.
